**Xvfb** is the X virtual framebuffer server for headless X11 sessions. It runs a full X11 server with no display hardware, drawing into an off-screen framebuffer.

Use it for headless/debug X11 sessions or software-only bring-up. The public Xios app display path uses **xios-server** instead.

- xorg-server 1.20.11 virtual framebuffer
- Registers `/var/jb/usr/bin/Xvfb`
- Pair with a window manager (`fluxbox`), `xterm`, and the `x11-fonts-sf` package

## 1.20.11+rootless1  ·  2026-06-29
- Rebuilt Xvfb from the same patched xorg-server 1.20.11 source as the X11-on-iOS stack
- Fix: XKB init spawns its xkbcomp helper via /var/jb/bin/sh (was /bin/sh), so keyboard init no longer crashes on rootless
- postinst creates the writable /var/jb/var/lib/xkb compiled-keymap dir
- Ad-hoc signed; installs cleanly with dpkg/apt
